description:
You are the IT Operations Director at a growing company. The support team is being reorganized to create a dedicated VIP support tier. Log in at http://localhost:8080 with admin@helpdesk.local / Admin123!.

Complete the following reorganization tasks:
1. Create a new mailbox named 'VIP Support' with email vip@helpdesk.local
2. The agent Alex Chen (alex.chen@helpdesk.local) is being moved to the VIP Support team. Remove Alex Chen's access to the 'Billing Support' mailbox, and grant Alex access to the new 'VIP Support' mailbox
3. Grant agent Maria Rodriguez (maria.rodriguez@helpdesk.local) access to the 'Technical Support' mailbox AND the 'VIP Support' mailbox (she currently has access to 'General Support' only)
4. Create a saved reply named 'VIP Priority Response' with the following body: 'Dear valued customer, your case has been flagged as high priority and assigned to our dedicated VIP support team. A senior support specialist will contact you within 1 business hour.'
5. Find all conversations currently tagged 'vip' (there are 4 such conversations across the General Support and Technical Support mailboxes) and move each one to the 'VIP Support' mailbox
6. Assign all conversations now in the 'VIP Support' mailbox to Alex Chen
